title: Teddy Hale's bolero tap to Begin the Beguine
summary: Green recalls Hale wanting to tap the Begin the Beguine bolero, popularised by Eddie Heywood's recording; the talk drifts into royalties and unions.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song
